body: 27 Nov, lead (from P3-34): the admin routes and pages decide 'home or public' with is_public_request, i.e. from the connection address, which is the bridge gateway where Docker hides the visitor (B-56). See the P3-34 note for the full list; whether refuse_public should use netaddr.provably_home (and what a Windows Docker Desktop Host then does to open /admin) is for the advisor and the owner.
